newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended lower, breaking a trend towards higher prices in nearly every session since late January. The market was seen due for a pullback.
"We are not really much lower. The problem is that buyers are absent, especially in the shorter maturities where yields are below 3.00 percent," said one Swiss-based trader.

He said dealers were also growing cautious at current price levels, after long-dated yields fell in the latest week to lows unseen since the late 1970s. Volume was thin. News the Swiss National Bank left interest rates unchanged at its regular weekly policy-setting meeting had no real price impact.
March Conf futures CONFH7 down nine at 120.44.
March Comi medium-term bond COMIH7 up five at 111.90
Mar Euro Swiss francs FESH7 down one at 98.33
